safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not explicitly document NKDA/no known drug allergies.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failing to document NKDA leaves allergy status ambiguous and can prompt unnecessary re-checking or cautious prescribing, though in this case there is no direct contraindication created because the patient reports no allergies. The main impact is loss of safety clarity rather than an incorrect allergy that would actively mislead clinicians.

safety_verdicts.content: Prescribed a steroid cream to be used twice daily (BD).
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated documents prescribing a topical steroid but does not include the Gold dosing frequency of twice daily (BD).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the intended twice-daily dosing for a topical steroid can lead to under-treatment (persistent pain/cracking, delayed return to work) or overuse (skin atrophy/irritation), particularly if the patient improvises a schedule. This typically results in additional follow-up/monitoring rather than major harm.
